Haiti is living through one of the world’s most acute security crises.

Economic hardship is fuelling unrest, Israeli incursions continue in the south and sectarian tensions persist in Sweida, even as Damascus reports progress on its chemical weapons programme and talks about future elections. Millions, meanwhile, remain displaced. Follow live below and go here for full meetings coverage.

title: ‘Efficiency has limits’: UNHCR chief warns refugee protection is buckling under cuts
